populations.id_rotation_note: Only 18.3% of window failures appear in the 2019-12-31 snapshot; this is a selected-population diagnostic, not a general ceiling.

baselines.ml_gbdt: pooled LightGBM(300 trees, lr=0.05, scale_pos_weight), model one-hot, native NaN

validity_labels.leakage-free: DRIVE strategies + random use pre-decision history but only on the snapshot-present population
validity_labels.post-outcome-diagnostic: SMART threshold uses 2019-12-31 features after the Q4 2019 outcome window
validity_labels.invalid-in-sample: ML models are fit and scored on the same Q4 2019 failure labels and use post-outcome features

benchmark_validity: No SMART or ML performance value is a valid held-out prediction estimate; exclude these scores from comparative claims.
